title: Bootstrap: governance package, schemas, gatecheck, workspace skeleton, CI, design plan
summary: The genesis packet. Establishes the rules (docs/governance), the machine-checked handoff schemas, the gatecheck validator, the pinned toolchain, the Cargo workspace with empty subsystem crates, the read-only upstream submodules, the CI workflow, and the design plan with the first backlog packets. Contains no editor behavior. Reviewed by the owner because there is no gatekeeper above the gatekeeper.

lane.reason: Needs the owner's GitHub credentials to open the PR, the macOS toolchain to prove the workspace builds on the target, and the owner's eyes on the licensing and toolkit decisions.
